title: Uniform bounds for planar polynomial limit cycles
main_claim: For every degree d there is a finite B(d) such that every real planar polynomial vector field of degree at most d has at most B(d) limit cycles. This is the uniform-boundedness half of Hilbert's 16th problem, part 2. The proof reduces it to "absolute isolated-zero finiteness" of finitely many matching systems, then applies a projection or component-counting theorem.

issues.location: Sections 3-8 (Thm separation, Def packet, Thm absolute-zero in 05-elimination.tex, packet theorems in 06-08) and the 'Divergent enlarged tuples' paragraph of Sec 11
issues.description: Not an identified error, but a statement of what was left unchecked. The whole result rests on the quasianalyticity and separation machinery: two-sided trees of band expansions, upgrading weighted Cauchy corrections to exact vanishing, and retestability of terminal coefficient germs under free-input perturbation. The absolute-zero proof of Thm 11 matching-system applies this machinery to arbitrary closure systems, including multiplier and critical-point systems. This core runs about 7k lines of new, non-standard analysis. It is claimed rather than reduced to known results (the cited Ilyashenko/Ecalle and Kaiser-Rolin-Speissegger work does not cover it), and I could not check it at referee depth. No specific failing step was found in the parts I sampled.
issues.evidence: Thm absolute-zero proof: 'At every sufficiently far anchor the resulting chart satisfies identically zero formal data... Separation therefore says that the actual normalized equations vanish at all sufficiently far perturbed points.'

coverage:
Read the introduction and all of Sec 11 (counting). I checked these line by line and found them sound:
- Projection count Thm: square-case induction on the number of parameters via a generic tilt plus Sard/Fubini. Dimension counts (2n+1 unknowns/equations; universal locus of dim(b,l)), the bordered-Hessian equivalence, the treatment of exceptional b, and the positive-dimensional witness-fiber step all hold.
- Matching-system construction: connector ODE derivation (dz/ds=(Delta/r)V_Y/V_X with Delta/r=r), the cyclic rank argument (prod h_j != 1 for hyperbolic), and component injection by analytic continuation of E^{-1}(C).
- Rotation lemma: re-derived w' = div V * w + |V|^2 using det(V,JV)=|V|^2. The psi(r)=a r^m root analysis and the max(O+2E+, O+2E-) >= O+E+ + E- count are correct.
- Final assembly with spatial rescaling.
- Sec 9 (subdivision): Lion-Rolin preparation usage, the pole-radius construction, the box-induction termination measure 2m+e (including the case-1 jet-order drop, since P_0 lacks a t^{i-1} term), the resonance-redo termination, and the Jordan-curve crossing lemma bounding word length.
- Sampled the Def packet / Thm separation statements and the Thm absolute-zero proof in Sec 5.
Not verified in detail: proofs in Secs 2-8 (flags, separation, calculus, elimination, additive/regular/mixed packet theorems) and Sec 10 (terminal reductions). These carry the deep analytic content.
